Dave Matthews Band

Xfinity Theatre - Hartford, CT

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Cardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Rear of GA Pit, Stage Right Stack, Mics PAS @ 12'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.60 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.1.3 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Dave Matthews Band:

Notes:

¹ Swim Naked outro
² with "Can't Help Falling in Love" interpolation
